description.en: Runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of the OpenCode Go/Zen gateways: adds the x-opencode-session header they require, routes each model to the gateway that serves it, serves a live model list, and adds a sidebar panel for the URL, API key, models and recent requests.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跑一个本机 OpenAI 兼容端点，转发到 OpenCode 的 Go / Zen 网关：自动补上网关强制要求的 x-opencode-session 头，按模型归属选择网关，提供实时模型列表，并在侧边栏加一个面板用于配置地址、key、浏览模型与查看最近请求。
